[[File:Tokichi.png|250px|thumb|Tōkichi]]
(Japanese: '''トウキチ''' ''Tōkichi'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP176|Ariados, Amigos]]''. In the English dub, he was merely referred to with the title of {{wp|sensei}}.

He is the owner of the [[Pokémon Jujitsu Academy]] that is in between [[Goldenrod City]] and [[Ecruteak City]]. When {{an|Aya}} came to perfect and improve her training skills, Tōkichi took her under his wing and became her tutor. He and his {{p|Ariados}} helped Aya and her {{p|Venonat}} become better at {{pkmn|battle|battling}}. As well as being the owner of the academy, he partakes in many of the classes that the academy offers. In the class for improving battle techniques, he is the judge for each battle. 

After [[Jessie]], [[James]] and {{MTR}} stole all the students' Pokémon, Tōkichi, as well as Aya and the gang, chased after them. He used his Ariados's web in order to make a kite. Aya stated to {{Ash}} that creating and utilizing the kite is one of her master's greatest techniques. Using {{wp|ninja}} stars, he cut the balloon and cut the rope holding the stolen [[Poké Ball]]s.
